# Copilot Instructions

## UI/UX Design Intelligence

When working on UI/UX tasks (designing pages, creating components, choosing styles/colors/fonts, reviewing UI code, implementing animations, or improving user experience), reference the UI/UX Pro Max skill at `.github/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/SKILL.md`.

This skill provides:
- 99 UX guidelines organized by priority (Accessibility → Charts & Data)
- 50+ design styles with matching criteria
- 161 color palettes and 57 font pairings
- Pre-delivery checklists for visual quality, interaction, dark mode, layout, and accessibility
- Anti-patterns to avoid for professional UI

### Key Priorities (always follow this order):
1. **Accessibility** (CRITICAL) - Contrast 4.5:1, focus states, aria-labels, keyboard nav
2. **Touch & Interaction** (CRITICAL) - Min 44×44px targets, loading feedback, no hover-only
3. **Performance** (HIGH) - Lazy loading, image optimization, CLS < 0.1
4. **Style Selection** (HIGH) - Consistent style, SVG icons (no emoji), match product type
5. **Layout & Responsive** (HIGH) - Mobile-first, no horizontal scroll, systematic breakpoints
